english: Never have I seen such a beautiful sunset.
chinese: 我从未见过如此美丽的日落。
soundmark: /ˈnevər hæv aɪ siːn sʌtʃ ə ˈbjuːtɪfl ˈsʌnset/

grammar.label: 部分倒装
grammar.text: 否定词Never提前，助动词have提前

english: Not only does she sing well, but she also dances beautifully.
chinese: 她不仅唱歌好听，跳舞也很美。
soundmark: /nɒt ˈəʊnli dʌz ʃiː sɪŋ wel bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlsəʊ ˈdɑːnsɪz ˈbjuːtɪfli/

english: It was yesterday that I met him.
soundmark: /ɪt wɒz ˈjestədeɪ ðæt aɪ met hɪm/

english: It is English that I love most.
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ðæt aɪ lʌv məʊst/

english: Hardly had I arrived when it started to rain.
soundmark: /ˈhɑːrdli hæd aɪ əˈraɪvd wen ɪt ˈstɑːrtɪd tuː reɪn/

english: Only in this way can we solve the problem.
chinese: 只有这样我们才能解决问题。
soundmark: /ˈəʊnli ɪn ðɪs weɪ kæn wiː sɒlv ðə ˈprɒbləm/

grammar.label: 部分倒装
grammar.text: Only+状语提前，情态动词提前

english: So fast did he run that nobody could catch him.
chinese: 他跑得太快没人能追上。
soundmark: /səʊ fɑːst dɪd hiː rʌn ðæt ˈnəʊbɒdi kʊd kætʃ hɪm/

english: Not until then did I realize my mistake.
chinese: 直到那时我才意识到我的错误。
soundmark: /nɒt ʌnˈtɪl ðen dɪd aɪ ˈriːəlaɪz maɪ mɪˈsteɪk/

english: It is because of hard work that he succeeded.
chinese: 正是因为努力他才成功了。
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz bɪˈkɒz əv hɑːrd wɜːrk ðæt hiː səkˈsiːdɪd/

english: What is it that you want to say?
soundmark: /wɒt ɪz ɪt ðæt juː wɒnt tuː seɪ/

english: Seldom do we see such dedication.
chinese: 我们很少看到这样的奉献精神。

english: No sooner had he left than it began to rain.
soundmark: /nəʊ ˈsuːnər hæd hiː left ðæn ɪt bɪˈɡæn tuː reɪn/

english: On the wall hangs a beautiful painting.
chinese: 墙上挂着一幅美丽的画。
soundmark: /ɒn ðə wɔːl hæŋz ə ˈbjuːtɪfl ˈpeɪntɪŋ/

grammar.label: 全部倒装
grammar.text: 介词短语提前+谓语+主语

english: It was not until midnight that he came back.
soundmark: /ɪt wɒz nɒt ʌnˈtɪl ˈmɪdnaɪt ðæt hiː keɪm bæk/
